information:
## Please read the ["What is a Favorites Competition?"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WestviewCubingFavorites2023#28442-what-is-a-favorites-competition) tab before registering.

All profits from this competition will be donated to [Interfaith Community Services](https://www.interfaithservices.org/), [Rady Children's Hospital](https://www.rchsd.org/), and [St. Jude Children's Research Hospital](https://www.stjude.org/). 

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WestviewCubingFavorites2023#17574-competitor-responsibilities) tab.
